text:
maya: heads-up — the drift explorer is rendering a bunch of empty rows for recent quantized runs, especially entries from last night's runner CI. anyone else seeing blank cohorts?

sam: yep, saw that on staging. diff view shows 0/0 for a bunch of rows and the scorecard totals are null. dashboard query returns no metric for 'quality_regress'.

jordan: i think the runner changed the metric name in the latest PR. we renamed 'quality_regress' -> 'quality_regression_score' to be explicit. that would explain the mismatch.

maya: ah right — that rename was in rc/runner-3.4 (PR #842). didn't realize dashboards weren't aligned. Can we support both names until we deprecate the old one?

lia: quick option: add an ingest alias so new docs write under the new name but query can coalesce. small patch: metric_aliases = {"quality_regression_score": "quality_regress"}. i'll open a PR.

sam: ingest alias will fix new writes but historical docs in ES will be split. we'd either need a reindex or handle it at query-time. reindex might be heavy.

jordan: agreed. for short-term, do query-time coalesce in dashboard SQL/ES query. e.g., SELECT coalesce(sum(quality_regress), sum(quality_regression_score)) as total_quality FROM metrics WHERE ...

maya: good call. also update the diff drilldown to surface raw sample counts — right now diff just shows blank because the inner query returns no keys.

lia: plan: (1) add query-time coalesce to dashboard layer, (2) add ingest alias to runner transform, (3) schedule a reindex job for historical backfill. quick note — reindex command: `./scripts/reindex_metrics --from=2026-03-01 --index=metrics-v*`

eval-bot: nightly-eval triggered: nightly-eval/2311110000 finished. 3 failing jobs. logs: https://ci/reports/nightly-eval/2311110000

sam: logs show KeyError in eval-runner serializer: `KeyError: 'quality_regress'` at metrics/serializer.py:42 — serializer assumes old key exists.

jordan: i'll put a tolerant accessor in serializer that tries both keys: `value = doc.get('quality_regress') or doc.get('quality_regression_score')` and add a unit test. pushing to canary now.

maya: please include tests asserting both names ingest correctly and that dashboard coalesce returns consistent totals. ping product — they might want a stricter naming freeze so we avoid churn.

lia: PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/950 — includes ingest alias + dashboard query fix + unit tests. staging runs green locally.

sam: deploying canary to staging now. i'll watch the dashboard and the next nightly-eval run.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. after we stabilize, let's add a short incident note in #incidents and create a small doc in eng-ml/wiki about metric naming conventions and deprecation policy.

jordan: will follow up with the test coverage and reindex job ticket.

sam: quick FYI — if we go reindex route, let's throttle it to avoid ES pressure. use `--rate=2000/s`.

lia: noted. opening ticket for reindex ops + to schedule a maintenance window.

maya: ok closing this thread for now — reopen if the canary surfaces new issues. thanks all.
